prerequisites: The student masters the material from the Network Fundamentals course

learning_outcomes.text: The student can secure a layer 2 switch using the "best practices" explained in the theory section.
The student can separate network traffic using VLANs and implement them securely.
The student designs a layered network with different VLANs and can route network traffic between different subnets, different VLANs, and different physical locations.
The student secures a layer 3 network using ACLs.
The student can divide a network into different subnets using the VLSM method.

syllabus_topics: Lab assignments on SSH & port security

Lab assignments on Routing 
 static & dynamic

assessment_methods.method: Lab exams (2 or more per semester)

assessment_rules: The overall score is composed of 50% for the written theory exam and 50% for the lab exams. If the student scores less than 6/20 on one of the educational activities, the student can achieve a maximum of 9/20 for the entire course. Partial transfers for successful partial results (Theory and Lab) are possible within the academic year. Resits for theory are the same as the first exam period; resits for labs are individual, closed-book assignments to be completed within the exam session.
